content_sections.heading: KSLU Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The vacancy table on page 1 of the notification shows 26 Temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor positions and five Law Guest Faculty positions.

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Assistant Professor posts in Law, Management, Political Science or Sociology must have: A good academic record. A Master’s degree in the relevant subject with at least 55% marks. NET, SLET, SET or Ph.D. qualification in accordance with UGC Regulations 2018. Candidates must have a good academic record with at least 55% marks in the Master of Laws degree. Preference will be given to candidates possessing NET, SLET, SET or Ph.D. qualifications under UGC Regulations 2018.

rows.post_category: Non-UGC-qualified Guest Faculty with a Master’s degree and 55% marks
Retired Professor or practising advocate with 15 years of practice

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify an age limit for the Temporary Assistant Professor or Guest Faculty posts.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected through an interview. The university will communicate the interview date separately to eligible or shortlisted applicants. Applicants must produce their original certificates and documents for verification at the time of the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KSLU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the Karnataka State Law University website at kslu.karnataka.gov.in . Download the recruitment notification and prescribed proforma. Fill in the application form with the required personal, qualification and experience details. Affix a recent passport-size photograph in the space provided. Attach attested copies of mark sheets, degree certificates and other relevant documents. Send the hard copy of the application to the Registrar, Karnataka State Law University. Candidates may also send the application and documents through the specified email address. Ensure that the application reaches the university on or before 25 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: Application Address
content_sections.text: The Registrar Karnataka State Law University Navanagar, Hubballi – 580025 Karnataka

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Completed prescribed application form Recent passport-size photograph Master’s degree mark sheets and certificate NET, SLET or SET certificate, where applicable Ph.D. certificate, where applicable Teaching experience certificates Additional qualification certificates, if any Proof of published books and research papers, if applicable Other relevant supporting documents

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The application must reach the university by 25 September 2026. Candidates should use the prescribed application proforma. Attested copies of mark sheets, degree certificates and relevant documents must be submitted. Original certificates must be produced during the interview. Reservation will be provided according to Karnataka State Government rules. The appointments are purely temporary and on a contract basis. Assistant Professors will receive monthly consolidated remuneration. EPF and ESI statutory deductions are not applicable to these appointments.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under KSLU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 31 vacancies are available, including 26 Temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor posts and five Guest Faculty posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach Karnataka State Law University on or before 25 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Which subjects have Assistant Professor vacancies?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor vacancies are available in Law, Management, Political Science and Sociology.

faq.question: Q4. How many Law Assistant Professor vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 21 Temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor vacancies in Law.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for a Temporary Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Temporary Full-Time Assistant Professors will receive consolidated pay of ₹50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the remuneration for Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: Guest Faculty will receive ₹450 or ₹525 per hour, depending on their qualifications or professional category.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates generally need a relevant Master’s degree with at least 55% marks and NET, SLET, SET or Ph.D. qualification, as applicable under UGC Regulations 2018.
